title: How to encrypt and decrypt a string with a password
problem: I need to store an API key, a token, or a note encrypted under a password, and I do not want to hand-roll key derivation, salts, and initialisation vectors around the Web Crypto API.
outcome: A value encrypted under a password, stored as base64 text, decrypted back in a separate process, with the wrong-password case handled by name rather than by message text.

knowledge: A Node.js or browser project that can run async code
A password you already have somewhere safe, such as an environment variable
